The demonized immortal with snow-white hair: “Nuan Nuan, you are my inner demon.”
The zombie king of the apocalypse with an unwavering gaze: “Nuan Nuan, it’s your choice—kill me, or save me.”
Sheng Nuan became even more panicked…

89151.synopsis:
The unexpected fortune that came to me after death was quite ironic, given the misfortune that plagued my life. When I asked the King of the Underworld to let me live in the world of a novel, I never expected it to actually happen! The protagonist of the novel is a third-generation chaebol heir and a troublemaker at a hunter academy. But something about my reincarnation feels… off.
[(Sent via Web) Hello, Kang Shin-hyuk. You have been successfully selected for the position of swordsmanship instructor at the No. 1 Hunter Academy.] 
“Why… am I not the protagonist?!”
Instead, I’ve been reborn as a swordsmanship instructor at the academy, a mere side character in the novel.

89663.synopsis:
“Not a single young lady who bears the name of a noble is normal.”
“Pardon?”
“They’re either crazy or pretending not to be.”
Even such young ladies need attention and affection from time to time.

90943.synopsis:
After a car accident, she reincarnates as Satina, the villainess inside a dating simulation game!
She lives as a fake duke’s daughter, Satina Bersabet, without any of her memories……
On her twenty-third birthday, her fiancé kisses another woman. This shocking sight triggers the sudden return of memories from her past life.
“I am Liv, an AI system here to help you play.”
“This game runs solely for the player.”
“I will do my best to ensure a smooth gaming experience from now on.”
She welcomes the system’s timely help as she struggles with her sudden memories, but her joy is short-lived.
Out of the one hundred endings Saint Maker holds for the villainess, only a single path avoids death or imprisonment: “100. Normal Ending!”
To make matters worse, the male leads who stand in her way all give off a dangerous aura.
Can she escape the watchful eyes of these five men and successfully flee to the free city-state of Planchel?

91199.synopsis:
At the age of eighteen, to escape bullying and seek protection, I, as a beta, pretended to be an omega and seduced the older alpha, Lu Ci. Later, at the age of twenty, I fled from Lu Ci overnight due to changes in my family.
When we met again, he had become the most famous rising star in the business world. Late at night, when everything was quiet, Lu Ci would always hold me in his arms, gently kissing my gland.
His gaze was dark and obsessive as he lifted my fingertips and softly bit them: “If I mark you a few more times, your whole body will be filled with my pheromones. Let’s see if by then, you’ll still dare to abandon me.”

91967.synopsis:
For dragons, blending in among humans while concealing their true identity is considered a form of entertainment—a game.
A Gold Dragon enrolls in an academy under the guise of learning herbology, using it as an excuse to indulge in his own game. Taking on the false identity of ‘Adrian Heather’, he eagerly begins his academy life. 
However, his excitement is short-lived. He unexpectedly ends up sharing a dorm room with the esteemed Prince Mikhail—a situation that drastically alters his original plans. 
Though his days with Mikhail turn out to be unexpectedly enjoyable, the Gold Dragon’s ultimate goal remains the same: to finish this game quietly and disappear. 
And so, he does. By faking his own death, he vanishes from his friend’s life, believing the game to be over. 
That is, until his friend summons him back with a wish…
* * *
Mikhail, now in possession of a dragon’s golden scale, stroked it lightly. 
As if responding to the touch, the legendary Gold Dragon materialized before him. 
“Summoner, I shall grant you one wish.” 
But why did this dragon look exactly like Adrian Heather?
Suspicious, the prince demanded an explanation, but the Gold Dragon remained adamant in his denial.
“I merely manifested in the form the Summoner desired.”
After a brief moment of hesitation, Mikhail finally stated his one and only wish… 
“I want to find Adrian Heather’s body.”

92479.synopsis:
“If you’ve tamed me, you must take responsibility till the end.”
She possessed Merrien, the saint from a novel she had only read three chapters of.
The problem was, that Merrien was an extra who gets kidnapped and killed by the Archmage.
In this situation, she had no choice but to fill up the healing gauge as the damn system window commanded and return to reality!
As she was firmly determined and quickly filled up the healing gauge.
“Arf!”
“……How cute!”
A white ball of fluff appeared and wiggled in front of Merrien.
So she just healed that little white thing with her holy power, but…
“Hello, Merri. It’s our first time meeting in this form.”
For some reason, the white fluff transformed into a sickly handsome man.
And not just any man, but ‘Duke Ariel Hartez’, the Archmage’s younger brother.
***
“Merri, I told you before. I’d make the Archmage kneel before you.”
Ariel certainly did say that. After all, it was the condition of the ‘contract’ from the beginning.
However…
‘You never said that you were the Archmage!’
She firmly believed he was the Archmage’s younger brother, but what kind of situation was this?
While Merrien was busy racking her brains, Ariel grasped Merrien’s hand and brought it to his neck like a dog collar.
“If you’ve tamed me, you must take responsibility till the end.”
“……”
“Woof woof.”
[▶Error◀ Healing gauge has been reset to zero.] 
[Healing Gauge 0/10000] 
It seemed something had gone terribly wrong.
#Misunderstanding #Misconception #Healing the sly, sickly Archmage for the sunshine protagonist #There’s no way my little white fluff could be the Archmage
associated_names: 흑막의 병약 남동생을 치유한 줄 알았는데

92735.synopsis:
A world where there’s a protagonist, and the role of heroine is assigned to beautiful women.
I became one of the heroines in an unknown [dating sim] world.
A heroine who absolutely cannot be “conquered” by anyone.
… By the way, it turns out that not being “conquered” is mandatory.
Because, in order to escape this world, I must not fall in love with anyone.
associated_names: [TS] The Unconquerable Heroine of a Dating Sim (Official)

94271.synopsis:
“A peaceful Elven village, under attack by the Orcs.”
“Orcs setting fire to a peaceful Elven forest.”
Phrases like these are all too common.
But why exactly are they attacking the Elven lands?
How did they amass such a force to threaten entire nations?
This is a tale that dares to question such mysteries in a modern fantasy setting.
With the advance of science and the rise of the Industrial Revolution, the age has shifted from “swords and sorcery” to an era of “guns and magic.”
The Allied Nation of Orcs, Kobolds, Dwarves, Great Eagles, and Great Wolves, known as Orcsen; and the Elven Kingdom of Elfynd, an ancient, pure land even revered by Humans, have long-standing historical animosity.
At the border between these two rival nations, Orc King and the ruler of Orcsen, Gustav Falkenhayn, and Dineluth Andariel, the chieftain of the dark elves who have been exiled from their homeland by brutal ethnic cleansing, had a fateful encounter.
As these two nations wage a total war for their very survival, and as fate brings these two leaders together under dire circumstances, the question remains: What will become of their destinies?
Military, domestic affairs, diplomacy.
Land, sea, air.
An overwhelming tale of countless people, countless stories, and countless lives.
Thus begins a grand modern historical fantasy epic from another world.
associated_names: オルクセン王国史　～野蛮なオークの国は、如何にして平和なエルフの国を焼き払うに至ったか～

94527.synopsis:
In the 1970s after an unexpected event shakes the Meng family, Meng Yinyin is forced to move to the countryside.  
Having been pampered since childhood, she tries to adapt to the heavy rural labor. But as she stares at her blistered hands and slightly tanned skin, she comes to a painful realization: she really can’t handle this hardship (╥﹏╥).  
Left with no choice, she follows her parents’ last advice—if she can’t bear it anymore, find a good man to marry!  
After careful consideration, Meng Yinyin sets her sights on Lu Chen, a strong, healthy, and handsome man who’s orphaned and owns both land and property. Though he’s a bit cold, everything else about him is perfect, and most importantly, being with him means she’ll get to eat well!  
Just as things seem to be going her way, Meng Yinyin realizes that her life is actually unfolding within a novel. Lu Chen is the book’s main villain, who turns dark after being unable to win the female lead’s love and relentlessly torments her.  
The good news: she’s not the female lead. She’s merely a supporting character meant to highlight the female lead’s virtues.  
The bad news: Lu Chen is right outside her door, bringing her the meat she’s been craving for ages.  
When no response comes from inside the house, the man hesitates before gently asking, “Don’t feel like eating meat today? Should I catch some fish for you in the river instead?”  
Inside, Meng Yinyin bites her blanket, torn with frustration: should she open the door or not?  
*  
Lu Chen — In The Little Days of the 1970s, he’s the most popular male supporting character. Handsome and capable, he’s forever indebted to the female lead for a favor she did him in his youth. But since she marries someone else, he lives his life alone and dies in solitude.  
Lin Xiuzi, a woman from the 21st century, transmigrates into the book as the original female lead. Seeing the shabby in-laws, the filthy, unruly child, and her bedridden husband injured on duty, she swiftly files for divorce and decides to pursue Lu Chen, who has always been devoted to the female lead.  
As long as she marries Lu Chen now, she’ll enjoy his unwavering affection and one day become the wife of the richest man, basking in endless wealth and glory!  
Leaving behind her wailing child and her husband’s desperate pleas, she rushes to Lu Chen’s house—only to find him holding a pretty girl’s hand, anxiously asking, “Did you talk to uncle and aunt about our wedding plans?”  
Lin Xiuzi is stunned: wasn’t Lu Chen supposed to remain single out of love for the female lead? What is happening now?  
And the girl he’s marrying is none other than the supporting character who admired the male lead’s talent and constantly competed with the female lead!  
In response, Meng Yinyin shrugs: “Whoever wants to be a ‘control group’ can go right ahead. Being a cherished little darling is much sweeter, isn’t it?”

95039.synopsis:
Li Suimei knew that Qin Qing would disdain to attend her engagement ceremony with Qin Zhan.
After all, as a vicious female supporting character, Li Suimei’s role as a stepping stone for the male and female leads was almost over.
Why would Qin Qing come to help her?
Li Suimei chuckled bitterly. She had heard rumors about Qin Qing being very protective of her loved ones, but she didn’t know who had spread those rumors.
——At the engagement ceremony, Qin Qing, who was originally not supposed to attend, suddenly appeared. Wearing a snow-white wedding dress, she stood in the position that should have belonged to the male protagonist and said expressionlessly,
“Now, you are my wife.”
Li Suimei: “…”
Didn’t this person seem indifferent towards her just yesterday?
••••
Small Theater:
Qin Qing pinched Li Suimei’s wrist, her gaze fierce, “Back then, I always thought, you invited me to dinner and movies, stayed up late with me to go through documents, hugged my arm and cried, calling me ‘sister.’ Whenever I got angry, you would get nervous, and you even walked in and out of my room in your pajamas. If that wasn’t love, what was it?”
Li Suimei looked confused, “When did I bent?”
Qin Qing: “…”
associated_names: 穿书后我嫁给了男主姐姐

95295.synopsis:
There’s Definitely Something Wrong with the Dungeon I’m Challenging!
In a modern world where dungeons are an everyday reality, explorers are ranked based on their magical power to ensure fairness. From the moment I was a fetus, my magic levels were so off the charts that I broke every measurement device. This made me the world’s fastest-ever S-rank explorer, earning me immense expectations from everyone.
However, sixteen years later… I became the only S-rank explorer in history with zero dungeon clears. My illustrious title of “world’s fastest S-rank explorer” had morphed into a slew of humiliating nicknames: “world’s weakest S-rank explorer,” “peak power as a fetus,” “the man whose prime was before birth,” and “S-rank slacker extraordinaire.”
But seriously, there’s no way this is normal! Other dungeons have a maximum of 100 floors, so why does the dungeon I’m challenging have 501 floors!?
The world will eventually come to realize this truth: the man they mocked and scorned was, in fact, the strongest explorer in history.
associated_names: 世界最弱のSランク探索者として非難されていた俺、実は世界最強の探索者

95551.synopsis:
Jiang Huai transmigrates into the body of a privileged young master from an influential family. Before he can enjoy the riches and luxury, his family is disgraced and sent into exile, embarking on a long and arduous journey.
Fortunately, the heavens don’t close all doors. Jiang Huai realizes he has transmigrated into a novel. Five years later, a new emperor will ascend the throne, and the Jiang family will be exonerated, rising once again to prominence.
The problem? Jiang Huai is a mere cannon fodder character who dies of illness during the exile, never living to see the day of glory.
Determined to survive those five critical years, Jiang Huai carefully picks himself a “big brother” and bodyguard.
Jiang Huai paints a rosy future for his new protector: “I’ll reward you greatly for your help. In five years, you’ll live a life of wealth and comfort.”
The “big brother” remains silent, and Jiang Huai assumes he’s just shy.
Fast forward five years. Jiang Huai has built a modest fortune on the frontier and eagerly awaits the news of the new emperor’s enthronement and the subsequent pardon. Excited, he travels to the capital to reunite with his “big brother,” ready to make his mark in the bustling city.
But when he sees his “big brother” seated on the emperor’s throne, Jiang Huai is stunned. He turns to flee, only for the new emperor to block his way with a deep gaze.
“Didn’t you ask me to prepare a house for us in the capital?” the emperor says. “I’ve already bought it. Don’t you want to see our new home?”

96063.synopsis:
Good news: I’ve been reincarnated into another world!
Bad news: It’s the kind of story where I’m kicked out of the team.
Worse news: I’m the villainous lady captain in charge of kicking people out.
Even worse news: Sooner or later, I’ll be brutally mu*dered by the protagonist seeking revenge and the overpowered teammates.
To avoid being killed by:
The original “Phoenix-like, Feng Aotian” who is blindly trusted by the system,
The “overly passionate and heavy-handed war goddess,”
The “bloodthirsty yandere assassin,”
And the “scheming demon tribe member”…
Note: Feng Aotian is like the trope Long Aotian, which is basically the “main character” with all the OP powers and plot line skewed towards them etc
associated_names: 退队流恶役大小姐想和凤傲天贴贴

96831.synopsis:
After my skull was cracked open as karmic retribution for my delinquent acts, I regained the memories of my past life.
Only then did I realize I was walking a tightrope on the edge of a cliff.
But I can’t just give up being a delinquent, can I?

97599.synopsis:
I am a villainous noblewoman. — Probably.
A story about a noblewoman who resolves to lose nothing by abandoning any desire for a happy ending, and the prince who is her fiancé.

98879.synopsis:
In an era where only the fittest survive, Yujin, born weak and powerless, was forcibly taken from his small settlement to live among the Mounted Tribe. 
Without family or friends, he grew weary of merely surviving and even contemplated ending his life. Yet, every time he teetered on the edge, he found himself saved by Bart, the tribe’s most exceptional warrior. 
From that point on, Yujin began to feel a faint spark of energy to keep living, and alongside it, a budding affection for Bart.
Though Bart never approached him first, he always saved Yujin’s life. And even when Yujin drew closer, Bart never pushed him away.
Yujin kept his feelings buried deep, quietly nursing his affection for Bart—until one day, Bart reached out to him first.

101439.synopsis:
Zhou Tong was framed by his junior brother and misunderstood by his master and senior sisters. In anger, he left the sect and joined a new faction instead!
At that moment, he opened the door to a brighter world.
A seductive and domineering demoness constantly tried to attack, hoping to make Zhou Tong surrender to her charm.
The second junior sister, unparalleled in swordsmanship, was illiterate but surprisingly skilled at writing love letters.
The third junior sister, a money-lover, willingly entrusted Zhou Tong with her secret stash of gold.
The most captivating of all was his stunning new master. She was actually…
…
As Zhou Tong’s new sect flourished and grew stronger, his former master and senior sisters wept with regret.
“Dear disciple, I was wrong. Please come back to me. I’m willing to do anything to make it up to you.”
“Yes, junior brother! Let us belong to you!”
Zhou Tong: “I’m a man of great ambition. How could I stoop to such disgrace? Get lost!”
associated_names: After being expelled from the sect, the master and the elder sister regretted it for the rest of their lives
被逐出宗门后，师尊师姐后悔终生

102975.synopsis:
A tourism town on the brink of collapse, with a guesthouse that has already shut down.
A guesthouse owner who takes over a “haunted house” and his assistant, who is in it for the money.

105535.synopsis:
7 years of unrequited love and another 7 years of relationship.
Kyeoul believed that the love completed over a long time with Ithae would continue forever and beyond.
But.
“Looks like he’s out with that person again today.”
There was a reason why Ithae was diagnosed with fatigue syndrome.
Meetings with another person, continuing since last spring.
Ithae no longer smiled when looking at Kyeoul, and Kyeoul simply resigned himself to looking at such an Ithae.
“If it’s not fate, we need to break up.”
For both Ithae’s sake and his own. Holding onto each other was wrong.
Rather, we needed to let go and at least preserve our memories.
That brilliant youth once upon a time.
So that the past, which burned with a bright fire, would no longer become pitiful.
Kwon Ithae (32).
Lived a monotonous life. Until meeting Kyeoul. After meeting Kyeoul, his monotonous world began to move. With trembling excitement and beauty. This thrilling feeling that love gives cannot last forever.
Choi Kyeoul (32).
Even 7 years of relationship turned out to be useless. Constant communication and meetings with a person who is not me. Cold attitude, different from before. There were no more reasons to desperately cling to this relationship. I just needed to let go, but somehow it turned out to be so difficult. With age, he absolutely couldn’t stand fatigue.
When to read: When you want to see the outcome of love irretrievably destroyed by fatigue.
Quote for empathy: “Ah, we need to break up.”

106303.synopsis:
【Single Female Lead + Power Fantasy + Decisive MC + Fast-Paced + No Power Suppression + Face-Slapping + Thrilling Battles】  
New Calendar Year 1, beasts ran rampant, and martial arts flourished.
New Calendar Year 1000, catastrophe struck again, and much of martial arts heritage was lost.
New Calendar Year 2025, humanity rose once more, but unfortunately, the legacy remained broken, and the peak combat power of martial artists was far weaker than before.  
Qin Xuan transmigrated, originally possessing extraordinary martial talent.
Until a game called “Virtual Girlfriend” automatically appeared on his phone.  
Loading the game actually drained his vitality, and just when everyone thought the genius had fallen…  
He discovered that the virtual girlfriend was a real person from the golden age of martial arts a thousand years ago.  
【Congratulations on helping your virtual girlfriend dispel the cold, you have obtained a complete Body Tempering Technique inheritance.】
【Congratulations on feeding your virtual girlfriend, you have gained Combat Intent, allowing you to achieve unity with heaven and man at any time.】
【Congratulations on helping your virtual girlfriend change clothes, you have obtained a Profound-tier Blade Technique inheritance.】
【Congratulations on helping your virtual girlfriend take a bath, you have received a Vitality Booster Pack.】
【Congratulations, you have unlocked the physical interaction feature… You poked a hole through your phone screen, causing a time-space disorder, and your virtual girlfriend arrived a thousand years into the future…】
associated_names: 不是，玩电子女友，我咋成武神了

110655.synopsis:
Black hair and red eyes. 
The Red Witch considered to be a bad omen, Kiara has only one way to break her curse — to spend her first night with someone who carries the blood of the royal house of Grandilgale.
But on the day of the wedding arranged for that very purpose, the one to lift her veil was none other than Ael, the man feared as the Mad Lion of the Battlefield.
“If it hurts, scream. I won’t stop.”
A night spent trying to break the curse and fulfill the duty of the royal bloodline. But that night ties them together as fated partners, bound to share each other’s destiny.
They search for a way to undo the bond and regain their freedom, but for some reason, Ael shows no intention of letting Kiara go.
“You can return to the capital with peace of mind and I… I’ve always dreamed of one day leaving Altnebra.”
“If you’d told me that earlier, I wouldn’t have been so hard on you.”
A life lived traveling from one hell to another, not having a single thing to call his own.
On the northern front, under orders from the Crown Prince, Ael conquered the region. And there, he met the Red Witch — and for the first time, he wanted something for himself.
Everything of yours, down to a single strand of hair, even the smallest moan, belongs to me. Because you, too, are a part of this damned North.

112703.synopsis:
After five years together, Pei Yanli had never once said “I love you,” and Luo Yunqing had always considered himself nothing more than a lover.
Until the day Pei Yanli fell to his death.
Only then did Luo Yunqing discover two golden rings that Pei Yanli had held tightly even in death, and a will prepared long ago, leaving all his fortune to Luo Yunqing. It was then Luo Yunqing finally understood—this man had loved him to death.
And Luo Yunqing had also loved Pei Yanli just as deeply.
After taking revenge, he jumped into the ocean, embracing Pei Yanli’s ashes without hesitation.
He never imagined that when he opened his eyes again, he’d be back in the summer he turned eighteen, just after the college entrance exams, the very year his wealthy birth parents found him.
This time, when his biological brother came asking him to return home and marry in place of their fake young master, Luo Yunqing slowly smiled and agreed.
Husband, here I come!
—
Pei Yanli had injured his legs in a car accident and struggled with recurring complications. Not wishing to burden his arranged marriage partner, he prepared divorce papers in advance and wheeled himself into their bedroom on their wedding night.
But there he found the youth, kneeling on the bed with his slender, pale legs bare, loosely dressed in a silk shirt slipping off his shoulders. The boy blinked innocently and called softly, kitten-like:
“Husband~”
Pei Yanli’s grip tightened on the wheelchair’s armrest.
Divorcing right after marriage seemed too unreasonable. Maybe… they should wait a little longer.
Without a word, he quietly tucked the divorce agreement away.
—
After marriage, Pei Yanli quickly realized one thing clearly: his partner was far too clingy.
Always wanting hugs, always wanting cuddles, trembling and snuggling into his arms whenever thunder rumbled, utterly pitiful.
Again and again, Pei Yanli lowered his boundaries, letting the boy come closer and closer.
Until one stormy night—
Worried about the boy being home alone, Pei Yanli hurried back mid-business meeting. Passing by an alley, his gaze caught on the sight of his supposedly timid, thunder-fearing little wife wielding a metal baseball bat, ruthlessly smashing it onto the fake young master’s childhood friend’s head.
Drops of blood splashed onto his cold face, his expression icy, like a ghost straight from hell.
Then, their eyes met amidst flashes of lightning and roaring thunder.
The bat clattered to the ground. Panicked, Luo Yunqing frantically wiped the blood from his face and stared pitifully through the pouring rain.
“H-husband, it’s thundering—I’m so scared…”
Thunder crashed above, but an eerie silence hung between them.
Just as Luo Yunqing’s heart sank into despair, the car door opened. Pei Yanli calmly held out an umbrella, gently took Luo Yunqing’s hand, guided him back into the car, carefully wiped away the bloody water from his face, and covered his ears before the next clap of thunder.
“Don’t be scared,” Pei Yanli whispered reassuringly, “your husband’s here.”

113983.synopsis:
Hello everyone, I’m Ludwig. My father is the famous Prince of Gotham, Bruce, and my grandfather Thomas is even more renowned in Gotham.
What? This world isn’t the one you’re familiar with?
Well of course — because I’m an all-powerful superhuman.
Alright, fine — the truth is, this is the Flashpoint world.
What? You’re asking what the Flashpoint world is?
Oh, that all started with Barry’s mission to save his mother…
But that’s not the main point. Because of the Flash’s repeated time travel, this world has started to crack.
And I, Ludwig, in order to protect the world I’ve worked so hard to maintain — to preserve the only fragile line of peace in the Flashpoint world — will send these intruders away, and return to my peaceful life.
Bruce: “Luci? Why do you keep talking to thin air?”
Ludwig: “That’s our audience. Never mind, you wouldn’t understand anyway.”
B (Bruce version): “Why is the me from a parallel world such a clueless sweetheart?!”

114751.synopsis:
In high school, I ran into an idol at the broadcasting station who went to the same dance academy as me. Later, I ended up working with him as a backup dancer, but….
“But have we really never met before? Your face looks so familiar.”
I don’t know why this jerk is pretending not to know me and striking up a conversation when he clearly remembers me.

118335.synopsis:
B-list actress Qin Que is constantly mocked for her inability to perform romantic scenes. Viewers ruthlessly comment: “I’ve been gutting fish at the market for ten years, yet even I’m not as cold as you!” When the omega opposite her gazes with tender affection, as an alpha, shouldn’t you at least react out of basic respect for their charm?  
Fans defend her, arguing that Qin Que excels in all other emotional scenes—her only weakness is romance, surely because she’s never been in love!  
At this point, it’s hard to tell if they’re fans or haters.  
Just as the internet ridicules Qin Que for being single at 25, the popular dating show Destined for You publicly invites her to join.  
Qin Que: “Sure.” (smiles)  
Had Qin Que known that Yan Qing—the A-list omega, wealthy film queen, and the epitome of beauty and sensuality—would also be on the show and paired with her, she would’ve carefully reconsidered whether she really needed this job.  
Yan Qing, a top-tier omega, ranks among the world’s “Most Desirable Omegas to Spend a Lifetime With.”  
When a blockhead meets an alluring enchantress, the internet’s gossip flames roar to life.  
On the first day of filming, Qin Que accidentally tackles Yan Qing to the ground.  
Yan Qing smiles gracefully, her fingers trailing along Qin Que’s well-defined arm. “Be careful.”  
Qin Que’s face flickers between embarrassment and panic, her usual composure shattered. “O-okay.”  
Her blush is genuine, her trembling hands unmistakable.  
Viewers cheer: “So you’re not completely immune after all!”  
Qin Que is suffering in silence.  
The rich scent of wine lingers in the air, stirring a buried hunger within her.  
As an alpha who was bitten by Yan Qing just days ago, she shivers in fear.  
“Sis, you’re not getting addicted to this, are you?”  
Yan Qing, an omega who’s always held prejudices against alphas, had already planned how to make the disrespectful alpha who dared approach her during her induced heat pay the price—until the clear-eyed alpha hesitantly offered,  
“Um, if you need pheromones… you can bite me.”  
Then she turned around, exposing her fair neck, faintly sweet with the scent of milk.  
The one who couldn’t resist was Yan Qing.

119103.synopsis:
Seok Mun-pyeong, the 3rd Team Leader of the Soul-Slaying Unit—one of the most peripheral posts in the entire Demonic Cult—didn’t think much of it when the War of the Demonic Dragons, the contest to select the cult’s next successor, was suddenly canceled. Even the outlandish news that the Cult Leader, a figure revered as the sky above the sky, had accomplished Rejuvenation was just a distant rumor to him.
He never imagined that this monumental event would become a fire dropped squarely on his own feet.
“Naturally, I’m not asking you to perform the standard duties of a Majeong. As you well know, you are not suited for such work. The role I have for you is something different. I want you to be His shadow, and at the same time, His tail.”
‘No way… when he says ‘Him,’ does he mean the ‘Him’ I’m thinking of?’
Seok Mun-pyeong was thrown into confusion. It sounded like madness, but the official’s expression was dead serious. A chill began to creep down his spine.
‘So, a Demonic Shadow is ‘His’ shadow, and I’m supposed to be both the shadow and the tail? A ‘tail’ means to track and report on His movements… Is he really ordering me to spy on the supreme Cult Leader?!’
“…Me?”

119615.synopsis:
